requiredLayers.role: phone primary article and reading order

patterns.observedFact: Desktop uses a 56px full-width header plus left navigation, central reading area and right outline; at 390px the sidebars disappear and the article becomes a single inset reading column.
patterns.interpretation: DangoUI documentation identity is a responsive technical reading system, not a desktop canvas scaled into a phone.
patterns.recommendation: Reflow by information priority: retain header and article, remove secondary columns on phone, and preserve reading order.
patterns.visualFunction: Separate global utilities, local navigation, primary reading and outline scanning into stable zones.
allowedTransformations: hide secondary sidebars at narrow widths
change article length while preserving zone hierarchy
forbiddenTransformations: retain desktop sidebars through uniform scale-down
turn all zones into floating cards
treat mobile header/title occlusion as a required brand cue

informationDensity.desktop: Dense navigation at the edges with a broad long-form reading column.
informationDensity.mobile: One readable content column with secondary navigation removed, not miniaturized.

requiredLayers.role: phone primary article and reading order

responsiveContract.desktop: Keep header, left navigation, broad reading column and right outline as four independently observable zones.
responsiveContract.mobile: Hide both secondary sidebars and reflow the article into one 390px column with 16px content insets; do not uniformly scale the desktop shell.
responsiveContract.sourceDefectBoundary: The captured fixed-header/title occlusion is observed but is not an invariant and must not be used as a fidelity requirement.

compositionContract.layerEvidencePolicy: Each mobile source/demo layer must use its own bounded header or inset-article region. A whole-page [0,0,1,1] rectangle cannot prove mobile reflow.

patterns.scope: Introduction article and held-out technical article structure
patterns.observedFact: The Introduction article is led by a 36px/700 H1 and 24px/600 H2 headings. Its first high-salience explanatory object is a broad light-gray technical-flow surface containing monospaced process text; dense prose, a layer explanation and further sections continue below it.
patterns.interpretation: The wide technical-flow object and the long title-to-model-to-detail rhythm are structural teaching devices, not optional decoration or a generic card-summary opportunity.
patterns.recommendation: Keep the technical-flow surface horizontally dominant inside the reading column and preserve downstream long-form section rhythm; do not replace it with a small row of summary cards.
patterns.visualFunction: Turn a long technical explanation into a wide process model followed by layered, multi-section reading.
allowedTransformations: reconstruct technical diagram with independent DOM/CSS
forbiddenTransformations: replace the wide monospaced technical-flow surface with generic cards
collapse the long-form article into a short summary
use a screenshot of the source diagram
claim an exact custom font family

variantContract.namingRule: Source and calibration Demo must use this same DOM/CSS structural variant name; run, attempt and capture labels are provenance metadata and must never be embedded in variant.

translationPolicy.reason: goal-contract.json contains no mayTranslate entry for Button composition aspect or crop changes.
translationPolicy.requiredDemoBehavior: Use the same normalized aspect for the source and Demo comparison regions. If the full Demo region cannot match, select bounded like-for-like module regions without changing reading order or omitting required layers.

forbiddenSubstitutions: identical card wrappers around every layer

patterns.observedFact: The Button reading column is 4186.765625px tall and proceeds through title, purpose, import, live two-column preview/code examples, API and theme-variable material.
patterns.interpretation: Reference-page identity depends on multiple technical modules and sustained vertical density; a single Primary Button specimen is insufficient structural evidence.
patterns.recommendation: Build a multi-module calibration page and declare at least two independently reviewable QA sections: preview/code usage and downstream API/theme reference density.
patterns.visualFunction: Progress from component purpose to executable examples and then to implementation reference material.
allowedTransformations: reflow preview/code columns on phone while retaining both
forbiddenTransformations: omit all downstream API/theme reference material

patterns.observedFact: The current page is marked by rgb(88, 84, 255) text over a pale-purple rounded row with an 8px radius.
patterns.interpretation: Purple is used as quiet wayfinding feedback here, not as a page-wide decorative field.
patterns.recommendation: Keep the cue local to navigation and subordinate to content hierarchy.
patterns.visualFunction: Show location without turning navigation into a dominant call-to-action.
allowedTransformations: move the current state to another row
forbiddenTransformations: expand purple across the whole sidebar

informationDensity.mode: one restrained current row among dense navigation

patterns.observedFact: The Primary Button is 77.15625×32px with white text, rgb(124, 102, 255) fill and 4px radius. Hover remains pixel-identical with no transform; focus adds an auto 1px outline, and click settles into the retained-focus state.
patterns.interpretation: Primary action emphasis is compact and stable. State clarity comes from focus visibility rather than invented hover spectacle or activated recoloring.
patterns.recommendation: Preserve component-scale geometry and the observed state sequence exactly for calibration; do not infer behavior for other variants.
patterns.visualFunction: Provide a clear but compact primary action inside a technical component system.
suitableFor: held-out action requiring the same component role
allowedTransformations: change button label while retaining role
change intrinsic width to fit a new short label

globalForbiddenExpansions: Mobile header/title occlusion as a desired invariant
